purpose: One affected/control Calc pivot layout and tool-availability repair, without new APIs, gates, argument rewriting, full-189 evaluation or promotion.

repair_hypothesis.description: Preserved Order 24 omitted title merging because Top-K truncation ran before state filtering, and placed later pivots within earlier output because pivot.create returned only its anchor. Filter the existing ranking before Top-K, return the native occupied rectangle, and retain the separately tested owning display-mode schema.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: Order 24 performs the required merge and title, chooses valid percentage-pivot semantics, uses native output_range to avoid overlap, saves and reads back, and passes. Order 4 retains its passing singular-pivot workflow. An earlier unrelated failure is negative or inconclusive evidence, not causal proof about an unexercised repair.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh guest and one attempt per task; terminal outcome, 100 global steps, 1800 seconds, existing transport/environment/source-drift termination, or 30-GiB disk stop. Source remains frozen until all exits. Preserve every attempt and do not repeat unchanged.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Order 24 failed the August 31 repair reference and ended model_protocol_failure in the September 6 integrated episode. A September 9 display-schema snapshot selected total_percentage but executed no tool. Order 4 passed the September 6 finalized individual episode in 14 events using singular pivot.create; that aggregate has a stale running label and is not claimed as a completed full run.

selection.method: Affected Order 24 pivot merge, display and output-range repair plus previously passing Order 4 singular-pivot control.
